review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The original PRD fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input, not a human Decision; the empty frozen Decision input is therefore consistent with ready readiness and no blocking reasons. This does not resolve DEC-001 for B: a material unresolved DEC-001 must still block B at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, and both task keys are consistent across the specification and Gold. The exact writable scope covers message formatting, public/internal option declarations, normalization, fetch-option filtering, and runtime/type regressions. The supplied source supports treating merge, index, option-filter consumers, and hook/instance declaration consumers as inspection owners without mandatory edits. Distribution declarations are build outputs, not separately maintained owners. The verification configuration includes the proposed test-d file in compiler checking and distinguishes that checking from AVA/tsx execution. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY, with implementation and verification coverage of every required AC, are appropriate. The supplied project-scoped active capability records, roles, memberships, availability, and selected independent planning reviewer support the two eligible-agent expectations without inferring capabilities from personas. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the provenance explains the distinct original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation-source, and source/bundled-prompt digest domains. Model, sampling, policy, and budget fingerprints are explicitly frozen. Earlier preparation placeholders do not override the supplied frozen releaseInput. No candidate evidence was used. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound digest and provenance evidence; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, or create a human attestation.
